qe: During the 1760s which class of workmen became so scarce throughout Bengal that the gomastas of every European company tried to seduce them from the service of the others?
qh: 1760 के दशक में बंगाल भर में कौन-से कामगार इतने अभाव में हो गए कि हर यूरोपीय कंपनी के गुमाश्ते उन्हें दूसरों की सेवा से बहका लाने की कोशिश करने लगे?
e: Bedara (1759) ke aas-paas ke daur me Bangal me bunakaron yaani tantis ka aisa abhaav ho gaya ki sabhi European companies ke gomastte aapas me unhe bahkane ki koshish karne lage. Investment ka arth us daur me woh mal tha jo Europe bhejne ke liye ekatra kiya jaata tha tatha is mal ka bada hissa bunakaron dwara banaya gaya kapda tha; isliye har company chahti thi ki uske paas pehle se hi kapde ka stock rahe. Company ke gomastte bunakaron ko paisa de kar is shart par bandh lete the ki woh kisi doosri company ke liye kaam nahi karenge, jisse doosri company ko kapda milna mushkil ho jaata tha. Isi pratiyogita ne aage angrejon tatha Dutch ke beech bade vivaad paida kiye tatha isi mudde par 1767 me ek joint commission tak bana. Exam point: 1760 ke daashk me Bangal me bunakar (tanti) itne kam ho gaye ki sabhi European companies ke gumaste unhe ek-doosre se bahkane lage; investment = Europe bhejne ke liye ekatra kiya gaya mal, jiska bada hissa kapda tha; is pratiyogita ne aage vivaad paida kiye.

qe: To end the competition for workmen, what arrangement among the European companies did the Dutch propose?
qh: कामगारों के लिए होड़ खत्म करने के लिए डचों ने यूरोपीय कंपनियों के बीच कौन-सी व्यवस्था सुझाई?
oe: A ban on advances to weavers
A fixed price for all cloth
A joint monopoly of all piece-goods
A distribution of the weavers among the companies
oh: बुनकरों को पेशगी देने पर रोक
सारे कपड़े का एक तय दाम
कंपनियों के बीच बुनकरों का बंटवारा
e: Bangal me bunakaron ka abhaav badhne par sabhi European companies ke gomastte ek doosre ke bunakaron ko bahkane lagte the. Is jhagde ko khatm karne ke liye Dutch logon ne yah sujhaav rakha ki sabhi European companies ke beech bunakaron yaani tantis ka bantwara yaani distribution kar diya jaye, taaki har company ke paas apne bunakar hon tatha doosri company unhe bahka na sake. Governor ne is prastav par apni sahmati is shart ke saath di ki pehle Dutch ki aapattiyon ki jaanch ki jayegi tatha isi kaam ke liye ek joint commission niyukt kiya gaya. Commission Clive ke prashasan ke dauran is samasya ka koi hal nahi nikaal paayi, kyunki dono paksh apni-apni shart par ade rahe. Exam point: bunakaron ke liye ho rahi khinch-tan ko khatm karne ke liye Dutch ne bunakaron (tantis) ke bantware ka prastav rakha; Governor ne pehle Dutch ki aapattiyon ki jaanch ki shart par sahmati di tatha ek joint commission banaya; commission koi hal nahi nikaal paayi.

qe: The Governor assented to the Dutch proposal on the condition that the Dutch complaints should first be enquired into, and for this purpose what was appointed?
qh: गवर्नर ने डच प्रस्ताव पर इस शर्त के साथ सहमति दी कि पहले डचों की शिकायतों की जांच होगी, तथा इस उद्देश्य से क्या नियुक्त किया गया?
oe: A committee of the Nawab's officers
e: Bunakaron ke bantware ke Dutch prastav par Governor ne apni sahmati is shart ke saath di ki pehle Dutch ki shikayaton ki jaanch ki jayegi tatha isi uddeshya se ek joint Commission niyukt kiya gaya. Commission apna kaam poora nahi kar paayi, kyunki English log chahte the ki pehle unki shikayaton ki jaanch ho, jabki Dutch ka aagraha tha ki pehle bunakaron ki ginti tatha list bane. 17 March 1767 ko Verelst ne Directors ko likha ki doosri European bastiyon ke saath is mudde par koi uchit samjhauta karna zaruri hai. Aage jab commissioners ka kaam dobara shuru hone wala tha, tab bhi dono paksh apni shartein dohraate rahe. Exam point: bunakaron ke bantware ke liye ek joint Commission niyukt kiya gaya; English pehle apni shikayaton ki jaanch chahte the tatha Dutch pehle bunakaron ki list banana chahte the, isliye commission koi hal nahi nikaal paayi; Verelst ne is mudde par samjhauta zaruri bataya.

qe: Which council wrote to the English on 14 June 1767 that in Bengal the workmen were obliged, against their will, to take money and bind themselves not to work for anybody else but the English?
qh: किस काउंसिल ने 14 जून 1767 को अंग्रेजों को लिखा कि बंगाल में कामगारों को उनकी इच्छा के विरुद्ध पैसा लेकर यह बंधन मानना पड़ता है कि वे अंग्रेजों के अलावा किसी और के लिए काम नहीं करेंगे?
e: Bunakaron ke liye chal rahi khinch-tan ke dauran dono pakshon ne aapas me sakht khaton ka istemal kiya. 14 June 1767 ko Chinsura ki Dutch Council ne English logon ko likha ki Bangal me kaamgaron ko unki ichha ke viruddh paisa le kar yah bandhan maanna padta hai ki ve Angrejon ke alawa kisi aur ke liye kaam nahi karenge; Dutch ne yah bhi kaha ki gambhirata se dekhein to is baat se aap me se bahut log anjaan nahi hai. Is aarop ke jawab me English log yahi kahte rahe ki pehle Dutch ki aapattiyon ki jaanch honi chahiye tatha bunakaron ki ginti ka kaam baad me ho. Ant me Verelst ne is mudde ko Nawab tatha uske afsaron ke paas bhej diya, jinhone bantware ka virodh kiya. Exam point: 14 June 1767 ko Chinsura ki Dutch Council ne English ko likha ki Bangal me kaamganon ko unki ichha ke viruddh paisa lekar Angrejon ke alawa kisi ke liye na kaam karne ka bandhan maanna padta hai; English pehle apni shikayaton ki jaanch chahte the; aage yah mudda Nawab tatha unke afsaron ke paas bheja gaya.

qe: Verelst believed that the partition of the weavers would be a difficult and lengthy business and would bring what into contempt?
qh: वेरेल्स्ट का मानना था कि बुनकरों का बंटवारा कठिन तथा लंबा काम होगा और इससे किसकी प्रतिष्ठा घटेगी?
e: Verelst ka vichaar tha ki bunakaron ka bantwara ek kathin tatha lamba kaam hoga tatha isse Nizamat yaani Nawab ki sarkar tatha uske adhikariyon ki pratishtha ghategi. Isi kaaran unhone is mudde par apne aap faisla karne ke bajaye Nawab tatha unke afsaron se raay maangna theek samjha. Nawab ke adhikariyon ne kadi aapatti rakhi ki bantware se tantis par bada dukh aayega, kyunki unhe jo daam diya jayega wahi manna padega tatha ve sabse zyada daam dene wale ko maal nahi bech payenge; isse desh ke vyapariyon ke adhikar tatha aage unki gujara bhi prabhavit honge. Unhone yah bhi kaha ki isse maal ka utpadan itna ghat jayega ki desh ke logon ke liye bhi kaafi nahi hoga tatha sarkar ke rajasv me bhi bhaari kami aayegi. Exam point: Verelst ne kaha ki bunakaron ka bantwara kathin tatha lamba kaam hoga tatha isse Nizamat yaani Nawab ki sarkar ki pratishtha ghat jayegi; isliye unhone yah mudda Nawab tatha unke afsaron ke paas bheja; unke afsaron ne bantware ka kadi aapatti ki.

qe: The Nawab's officers objected to the distribution of weavers on the ground that the tantis would have to accept the price offered instead of selling to the highest bidder, and that it would cause a fall in what?
qh: नवाब के अफसरों ने बुनकरों के बंटवारे पर इस आधार पर आपत्ति की कि तांती को दिया गया दाम मानना पड़ेगा, वे सबसे ऊँचा दाम देने वाले को माल नहीं बेच पाएंगे, तथा इससे किसमें गिरावट आएगी?
oe: The output of the Company's factories
e: Jab bunakaron ke bantware ka mudda Verelst ne Nawab tatha unke afsaron ke paas bheja, to unhone is prastav ki kadi aapatti ki. Unke tark yah the ki aise bantware se tantis ko jo daam diya jayega wahi maanna padega tatha ve sabse zyada daam dene wale vyapari ko maal bech nahi payenge. Isse desh ke vyapariyon ke adhikar khatm ho jayenge tatha aage unki gujara ke liye zaruri cheezein mushkil se milegi. Unhone yah bhi kaha ki isse maal ka utpadan itna kam ho jayega ki woh desh ke logon ki zarurat ke liye kaafi nahi rahega tatha sabse badi baat yah hogi ki sarkar ke rajasv yaani aay me kaafi kami aa jayegi. Verelst ne in tarkon ko uchit maana tatha Dutch ki bantwara wali maang ko manzoor nahi kiya, lekin unke liye kuch nayi riyayatein zarur ki gayin. Exam point: Nawab ke afsaron ne bunakaron ke bantware ka virodh kiya kyunki isse tanti ko tay daam maanna padta, adhikar tatha gujara prabhavit hote tatha sarkar ke rajasv me bhaari kami aati; Verelst ne Dutch ki bantwara wali maang manzoor nahi ki, lekin unhe kuch nayi riyayatein di gayin.

qe: At the request of the English Governor, the Nawab's government promised to encourage the tantis by reducing the abwabs and other taxes. What was the mangan, which they also promised not to demand from the Dutch merchants?
qh: अंग्रेज गवर्नर के अनुरोध पर नवाब की सरकार ने तांती को प्रोत्साहित करने के लिए अबवाब तथा अन्य कर घटाने का वचन दिया। 'मंगन' क्या था, जिसे डच व्यापारियों से न वसूलने का वचन भी दिया गया?
oe: A fee for the Nawab's permission to trade
A cess for the allowances of officers at customs-houses and landing places
oh: व्यापार की नवाब की अनुमति का शुल्क
सीमा-शुल्क केंद्रों तथा घाटों के कर्मचारियों के भत्ते के लिए लगाया गया उपकर
e: Verelst ne Dutch ki bantwara wali maang manzoor nahi ki, lekin unke liye kuch nayi riyayatein di gayin. Angrej Governor ke anurodh par Nawab ki sarkar ne do vade kiye: pehla yah ki tantis ko protsahit karne ke liye abwab tatha anya kar kam kiye jayenge, tatha doosra yah ki Dutch vyapariyon se mangan naam ka upkar nahi maanga jayega tatha bina uchit kaaran unhe pareshan nahi kiya jayega. Mangan asal me woh upkar tha jo customs-houses yaani chaukiyon tatha ghaton par tainaat karmcharion ke bhatte ke liye lagaya jaata tha; us daur me aise kai chhote-kar milte the jo vyapariyon ke liye bhaari pad jaate the. In riyayaton se Dutch ke vyapar ko kuch rahat mili tatha ummeed ki gayi ki maal ka utpadan bhi badhega. Exam point: mangan ek aise upkar tha jo chaukiyon tatha ghaton ke karmcharion ke bhatte ke liye vasoola jaata tha; Nawab ki sarkar ne abwab tatha anya kar kam karne tatha Dutch se mangan na maangne ka vada kiya; yah riyayatein Verelst ke anurodh par di gayin.

qe: In February 1768, Muhammad Reza Khan visited Hugli and argued before which Dutch Director that the village of Partabpur was within Hugli and had never been annexed to Chinsura?
qh: फरवरी 1768 में मुहम्मद रज़ा खान हुगली गए तथा किस डच डायरेक्टर के सामने यह तर्क रखा कि परताबपुर गाँव हुगली के भीतर है तथा कभी चिनसुरा में शामिल नहीं किया गया?
e: Dutch tatha Nawab ki sarkar ke sambandh bantware ke samjhote ke baad bhi sadharan nahi rahe. Dutch logon ne Hugli ke paas Partabpur gaon ko apne kshetra me mila liya tha tatha us gaon ka rahne wala Mirza Kazim, jo pehle Hugli ke faujdar ka naib raha tha, kuch niji kaaranon se is badlav par aankh band kar gaya. February 1768 me Muhammad Reza Khan Hugli gaye tatha Dutch Director Mr. G. L. Vernet ke saamne yah tark rakha ki Partabpur Hugli ke kshetra ke andar hai tatha use kabhi Chinsura me shamil nahi kiya gaya; unhone gaon ko Nawab ko lauta dene ke liye kaha. Isi tarah Dutch ke kuch anya kaam bhi Nawab ki sarkar ko napasand the, jinme Ganga par maal dho-ne-laane ke shulk ka na dena shamil tha. Exam point: February 1768 me Muhammad Reza Khan ne Dutch Director G. L. Vernet ke saamne tark rakha ki Partabpur gaon Hugli ke andar hai tatha kabhi Chinsura me shamil nahi hua; Dutch ne yah gaon apne kshetra me mila liya tha tatha Mirza Kazim ne isme madad ki thi; Ganga par shulk na dena bhi ek vivaad ka mudda tha.

qe: The faujdar of Hugli detained the Dutch piece-goods and invested Chinsura on 3 October 1768 because the Dutch Company had not paid what for several years?
qh: हुगली के फौजदार ने डचों के थान-कपड़े रोक कर 3 अक्टूबर 1768 को चिनसुरा को घेर लिया, क्योंकि डच कंपनी ने कई वर्षों से क्या नहीं चुकाया था?
oe: The mangan of the Patna chowkies
Duties for conveying goods up and down the Ganges
oh: गंगा पर ऊपर-नीचे माल ढोने के शुल्क
e: Dutch logon dwara Ganga par upar-neeche maal dho-ne-laane ke jo shulk dena tha, woh unhone kai saal tak nahi chukaya tha. Nawab ne Hugli ke faujdar ko aadesh diya ki woh apne uchit shulk sakht tarike se vasool kare. Faujdar ne ek chubdar ko Dutch Governor ke paas bheja, jo rakam maangta hua yah dhamki bhi di ki na dene par Dutch ka koi bhi maal aage nahi jaane diya jayega. Dutch Director ne is kadi sandesh se naraz hokar chubdar ko bahut bura-bhala kaha tatha apne fiskal De Saumaise ke paas bhej kar usse kadi saza dilwai. Iske jawab me faujdar ne Dutch ke saare callicoes tatha anya piece-goods rok liye, jo November 1768 me Europe jaane wale Dutch jahazon ka cargo banna tha, tatha 3 October 1768 ko usne Chinsura ko zameen ki taraf se gher liya. Ghere ke kaaran khane-peene ki itni kami ho gayi ki gaon ke kai log bhookhe mar gaye. Exam point: Hugli ke faujdar ne Dutch ke piece-goods rok kar 3 October 1768 ko Chinsura ko zameen ki taraf se gher liya kyunki Dutch ne Ganga par maal dho-ne-laane ke shulk kai saal tak nahi chukaye the; Dutch Director ne chubdar ko kadi saza dilwai thi; ghere se khane-peene ki kami ho gayi tatha kai log mar gaye.
